description: This is a C++ header file defining the MiracastPlayer class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. The class inherits from PluginHost::IPlugin, PluginHost::JSONRPC, and MiracastPlayerNotifier, and provides an interface for a Miracast player plugin, including methods for managing playback, video settings, and RTSP configurations. It also declares constants, member variables, and internal methods related to Miracast streaming functionalities.

classes.name: MiracastPlayer
classes.description: A plugin class implementing Miracast streaming capabilities and JSON-RPC interface within the WPEFramework. Manages Miracast session states, video settings, RTSP messaging, and interaction with GStreamer player.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided shell interface.

methods.name: information
methods.description: Returns a string describing the plugin.

methods.name: onStateChange
methods.description: Handles state change notifications for the Miracast client.

methods.name: testNotifier
methods.description: Test method for notifier functionality, enabled conditionally.

methods.name: playRequest
methods.description: Handles a request to start Miracast playback.

methods.name: stopRequest
methods.description: Handles a request to stop Miracast playback.

methods.name: setPlayerState
methods.description: Sets the player state (e.g., play, pause).

methods.name: reasonDescription
methods.description: Converts reason codes to descriptive strings.

methods.name: stateDescription
methods.description: Converts player state codes to descriptive strings.
